title: Remediation Backlog Registry
description: P12-024: Prioritised and tracked remediation backlog routing all measured defect classes to owning phases in Programme 12.

UNOWNED_CODE.title: Unowned repositories and orphaned surfaces
UNOWNED_CODE.remediationPlan: Exhaustive repository ownership mapping via programme-claims.json and check-programme-claim.mjs.

SCHEMA_OVERSIZED.title: core.prisma schema oversized (31,092 lines)
SCHEMA_OVERSIZED.remediationPlan: Modular schema decomposition splitting data models under 3,000 lines per domain context.

OUTBOX_TOPOLOGY.title: Outbox topology misplacement across layers
OUTBOX_TOPOLOGY.remediationPlan: Standardize transactional outbox contracts, envelope, and relay in L1 kernel and L0 contracts.

STANDALONE_BUILDS.title: Unresolvable workspace:* dependencies in standalone checkouts
STANDALONE_BUILDS.remediationPlan: Standardize published @kannan19302/* package resolution and clean standalone builds.

SANDBOX_CONFINEMENT.title: Sandbox confinement fragility and isolation verification
SANDBOX_CONFINEMENT.remediationPlan: True process/VM isolation barrier and runtime tenant capability confinement.

DOC_DRIFT.title: Documentation drift and unverified architectural claims
DOC_DRIFT.remediationPlan: Automated generation of contracts and architecture documentation from source with drift CI gates.

DECORATIVE_GATES.title: Decorative or unexecuted CI gates
DECORATIVE_GATES.remediationPlan: Cross-repo verify.mjs enforcement with zero skipped or unexecuted scripts.

COVERAGE_PADDING.title: Coverage padding tests without assertions
COVERAGE_PADDING.remediationPlan: Enforce strict falsifiable test quality gates and coverage ratchet verification.

MONOLITHIC_FILES.title: Files exceeding 1,000 line ceiling
MONOLITHIC_FILES.remediationPlan: Decompose monolithic source files and eliminate unreachable dead code.

REPOSITORY_HYGIENE.title: Stray root documents and self-nested directories
REPOSITORY_HYGIENE.remediationPlan: Enforce check-repo-hygiene.mjs preventing scratch files, evidence files and self-nested config.

SUPPLY_CHAIN.title: Supply chain security, SBOM and dependency vulnerabilities
SUPPLY_CHAIN.remediationPlan: CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM generation, OIDC attestations and dependency governance auditing.
